test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The sweet mangoes were eaten by the children.

options.text: The children were eating the sweet mangoes.
The children was eating the sweet mangoes.
The children are eating the sweet mangoes.
The children ate the sweet mangoes.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The children ate the sweet mangoes**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Past tense** and in **Passive Voice**.
 
• The rule for changing a sentence in **Past Tense** from **Passive Voice** to **Active Voice**:
 
 
• ​Interchange the object and the subject with each other, i.e. object of the passive sentence becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The helping verb get's removed as it is a simple past sentence.
 
• Convert the verb from the 3rd form of the verb to the 2nd form of the verb.
 
• **Structure: Subject + V2 + Object (Active Voice)**
 
 

**​ Object + was/were + V3 +by + Subject (Passive Voice)**

 
• **Solution:** *The sweet mangoes were eaten by the children. (Passive Voice)*

*​ The children ate the sweet mangoes. (Active Voice)*

 
• Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**The children ate the sweet mangoes**.'
